findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 195 requests to 55 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 26.2 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.8 MB (14%) came from third-party domains, 995 kB of it from services classified as tracking (123 requests).

25 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), creativecdn.com (RTB House, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), fastclick.net (Conversant, advertising).
74 cookies were set by third-party domains (105 cookies in total).

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 42 requests were blocked. The page still made 195 requests to 55 third-party domains, including 27 tracking services in our list.
